data.Q: Who gets the Lord’s message as the old prophet and the man from Judah sit?
What had the old prophet done to the man from Judah before this?
data.A: The old prophet had brought the man from Judah back.
data.wrong_answer: The old prophet cried out to the man from Judah.

data.Q: To whom does the old prophet direct his cry?
Why is the man from Judah told his body will not be buried with his fathers?
data.A: The man from Judah went back and ate and drank where the Lord forbade.

data.Q: Who told the man from Judah not to take food or water there?
Whose body is warned it will not rest in his fathers’ tomb?
